subject: Fix flakey mrmwmutex test (#863)
reason: The change modifies only unit test files (vmsdk/testing/log_test.cc, mrmw_mutex_test.cc, thread_pool_test.cc): it fixes flaky test logic, initializes test-local atomics, and re-enables tests previously disabled behind BROKEN_UNIT_TEST. No source file compiled into the valkey-search module is touched, so the module's runtime behaviour is identical at the change and its parent and no scenario can reach any changed behaviour.
